posts.text: California elections: how@Easy it to vote in the Los Angeles mayoral race without an ID and if you’re not registered in that city? People like @Xaviaer DuRousseau think it’s too easy. But it’s not.  Let’s fact check what California law says.

President Trump decided to cancel the $1.766 billion “slush fund” that was set up by the DOJ as part of the settlement that the IRS and Trump had reached for the president to drop his $10 billion lawsuit.  The decision was announced by Todd Blanche, since Donald Trump isn’t officially supposed to be involved with the fund.

Did senatorial candidate James Talarico text a former student at 11 o’clock at night? Let’s fact, check this news and see what really happened, but also compare James Talarico to Ken Paxton, and respond to @Victor Nieves

As America celebrates Pride Month during the month of June, Tennessee Republicans instituted “nuclear family month” and Tennessee representative Andy Ogles decided to publish an offensive post insulting millions of Americans saying that they have no place in the United States.  ##pridemonth🏳️‍🌈

Why does Trump continue going in for medical checkup and tests if he is in perfect health? This was a question posed by a member of the press to Dr. Oz. The answer Dr. Oz gave was puzzling and absolutely unbelievable.

Protests continue at Delaney Hall, the New Jersey immigration detention center managed by GEO group on behalf of ICE.  While accusations of poor living conditions continue, this  is what New Jersey US Rep. Jeff Van Drew said of the living conditions at Delaney Hall.

Was Donald Trump a draft dodger, even if his draft number never came up? Yes: Trump avoided the draft through student deferment four times and then avoided it indefinitely during the Vietnam war through a medical certificate that said he had bone spurs.  Let’s fact check @thebannedbeard13

Did Barack Obama charge President Biden $14 million in consulting fees during Biden‘s presidency? People like @Truly Salty think that is true, but they don’t realize that they read a satirical article and thought it was real.

San Diego Islamic center tragedy: After the tragedy at the Islamic Center in San Diego, many conservative creators wrote and condemned people that had nothing to do with it. Now that they found out that the suspects might be closer to them than they wished, those same conservative content, creators have gone completely silent.

Islamic communities in the United States have their traditions. But are they required to assimilate? Do They force their culture on others? Let’s fact check @patriotic_em and her belief that the Islamic culture behaves differently from Anglo-American culture.
